# Chip Compound Interest

An offline iOS and iPadOS compound interest calculator by Chirag Mirani. Includes growth charts, independent contribution and compounding frequencies, plan comparisons, contribution/time/return goal solvers, inflation-adjusted balances, PDF reports and CSV exports. Educational hypothetical calculations; no trading, financial accounts or investment advice. Paid once; no ads or subscriptions.

- [Home](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/)
- [Support](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/support.html)
- [Privacy](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/privacy.html)
